name: Chaitanya Dadi
lead: I'm Chaitanya, a Power BI developer with eight years of turning messy data into reports people actually open. Lift the lid below and build your own view of what I do.
about: I'm a Power BI and data developer with more than eight years in the IT industry. I design data models, write DAX, build data pipelines and turn business questions into reports and dashboards that teams use every day.

strengths.title: Models first
strengths.text: A clean star schema makes every report after it faster to build and easier to trust.

strengths.title: DAX that performs
strengths.text: Measures that are readable, tested and quick, even on big models.

strengths.title: Reports people open
strengths.text: One question per page, the answer at the top, detail one click away.

strengths.title: Pipelines that run themselves
strengths.text: Azure Data Factory and Microsoft Fabric keep the data fresh without anyone pressing refresh.

strengths.title: Always learning
strengths.text: Python, GitHub Actions and AI tools, starting with the script that runs this site's AI Hub.

skills.items: Report and dashboard design, DAX, Power Query (M), data modeling, row-level security, Power BI Service and gateways
SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, data warehousing, ETL pipelines
Python, GitHub Actions, HTML, CSS and JavaScript, large language models
